<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" name="viewport"/>
<title>Intelligence Report - Social Media Monitoring</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@700&family=Source+Code+Pro:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
        body {
            background-color: #1a1a1a;
            color: #f0f0f0;
            font-family: 'Source Code Pro', monospace;
        }
        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
        }
        .breaking-news {
            background-color: #b30000;
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 0;
            text-align: center;
            font-weight: bold;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }
        .sentiment-bar {
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin: 4px 0;
        }
        .negative { background-color: #ff4d4d; }
        .neutral { background-color: #cccccc; }
        .positive { background-color: #4CAF50; }
        .post-card {
            border-left: 3px solid #b30000;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        .post-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }
        .platform-tag {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 2px 8px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-right: 4px;
        }
        .twitter { background-color: #1da1f2; }
        .instagram { background-color: #e1306c; }
        .facebook { background-color: #4267B2; }
        .youtube { background-color: #FF0000; }
        .whatsapp { background-color: #25D366; }
        .donut-chart {
            width: 100px;
            height: 100px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .donut-chart::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: conic-gradient(#b30000 0% 60%, #1a1a1a 60% 100%);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        .timeline-item {
            position: relative;
            padding-left: 30px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .timeline-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 8px;
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background-color: #b30000;
        }
        .note-box {
            border-left: 4px solid #b30000;
            padding: 15px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
        }
        .keyword-chip {
            background-color: rgba(179, 0, 0, 0.2);
            border: 1px solid #b30000;
            color: #f0f0f0;
        }
    </style>
</head>
